info.title: PRKS API — Deployment settings slice
info.description: Vertical-slice OpenAPI for the deployment settings Settings shows (#612). Read-only: deployment values are set on the host and need a restart.

200.description: Every deployment setting with its effective value and source. Secrets and host paths show only that they are set.

403.description: The session's role is not the Library owner.

DeploymentSetting.description: One deployment setting as this web process read it at start.

key.description: The environment variable, such as PRKS_HTTP_THREADS.
key.title: Key

value.description: The effective value. For a default, the documented default; for a secret, '(set, hidden)'; for a path on the host, 'set on the host'.
value.title: Value

source.description: Where the value came from; the storage root may also come from the command line or the bootstrap file.
source.title: Source

editable_in_browser.description: Always false: these values are changed on the host and need a restart.
editable_in_browser.title: Editable In Browser
